Specification: This module specifies the Paxos consensus algorithm using message-passing between leaders and acceptors, and includes a TLAPS-checked proof of safety. The model tracks the set of sent messages and, for each acceptor, the highest ballot it has participated in and the highest ballot/value it has voted for. It assumes quorums are subsets of acceptors with pairwise nonempty intersection, proves an inductive invariant, proves consistency of chosen values, and finally proves refinement to an abstract consensus specification imported from the Consensus module.
TheoremNames:
LEMMA VotedInv == 
        MsgInv /\ TypeOK => 
            \A a \in Acceptors, v \in Values, b \in Ballots :
                VotedForIn(a, v, b) => SafeAt(v, b) /\ b =< maxVBal[a]

LEMMA VotedOnce == 
        MsgInv =>  \A a1, a2 \in Acceptors, b \in Ballots, v1, v2 \in Values :
                       VotedForIn(a1, v1, b) /\ VotedForIn(a2, v2, b) => (v1 = v2)

LEMMA SafeAtStable == Inv /\ Next /\ TypeOK' => 
                          \A v \in Values, b \in Ballots:
                                  SafeAt(v, b) => SafeAt(v, b)'
FunctionConstructor: [type : {"1b"}, bal : Ballots, maxVBal : Ballots \cup {-1}, maxVal : Values \cup {None}, acc : Acceptors]
[type : {"2b"}, bal : Ballots, val : Values, acc : Acceptors]
RecordConstructor:
[type |-> "1b", bal |-> m.bal, maxVBal |-> maxVBal[a], 
               maxVal |-> maxVal[a], acc |-> a]
[type |-> "2b", bal |-> m.bal, val |-> m.val, acc |-> a]

[type : {"1b"}, bal : Ballots, maxVBal : Ballots \cup {-1},
                    maxVal : Values \cup {None}, acc : Acceptors]
[type : {"2b"}, bal : Ballots, val : Values, acc : Acceptors]
[type |-> "2b", val |-> vv, bal |-> bb, acc |-> aa]
AssumeProveBlocks:
SUFFICES ASSUME Inv, Next, TypeOK',
                    NEW v \in Values, NEW b \in Ballots, SafeAt(v, b)
             PROVE  SafeAt(v, b)'

ASSUME NEW bb \in Ballots, Phase1a(bb)
      PROVE  SafeAt(v, b)'

ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase1b(a)
      PROVE  SafeAt(v, b)'

ASSUME NEW bb \in Ballots, Phase2a(bb)
      PROVE  SafeAt(v, b)'

ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase2b(a)
      PROVE  SafeAt(v, b)'

ASSUME NEW aa \in Acceptors, NEW bb \in Ballots,
               WontVoteIn(aa, bb), NEW vv \in Values,
               VotedForIn(aa, vv, bb)'
        PROVE FALSE

SUFFICES ASSUME Inv, Next
               PROVE  Inv'
ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase1a(b) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase2a(b) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase1b(a) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase2b(a) PROVE TypeOK'
ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase1a(b) PROVE AccInv'
ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase2a(b) PROVE AccInv'
ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase1b(a) PROVE AccInv'
ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase2b(a) PROVE AccInv'

ASSUME NEW acc \in Acceptors, maxVBal'[acc] >= 0
            PROVE  VotedForIn(acc, maxVal[acc], maxVBal[acc])'

ASSUME NEW acc \in Acceptors, NEW c \in Ballots, c > maxVBal'[acc],
                   NEW v \in Values, VotedForIn(acc, v, c)'
            PROVE  FALSE

ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase1a(b)
          PROVE  MsgInv'

ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase1b(a)
          PROVE  MsgInv'

ASSUME NEW b \in Ballots, Phase2a(b)
          PROVE  MsgInv'

ASSUME NEW c \in 0 .. (b-1),
                     \A m \in S : m.maxVBal =< c,
                     NEW ma \in S, ma.maxVBal = c, ma.maxVal = v
              PROVE  SafeAt(v,b)

SUFFICES ASSUME NEW d \in 0 .. (b-1)
                        PROVE  \E QQ \in Quorums : \A q \in QQ : 
                                  VotedForIn(q,v,d) \/ WontVoteIn(q,d)

ASSUME NEW a \in Acceptors, Phase2b(a)
          PROVE  MsgInv'

SUFFICES ASSUME Inv,  
                      NEW v1 \in Values,  NEW v2 \in Values, 
                      NEW b1 \in Ballots, NEW b2 \in Ballots,
                      ChosenIn(v1, b1), ChosenIn(v2, b2),
                      b1 =< b2
               PROVE  v1 = v2

SUFFICES ASSUME TypeOK', Consistency', Next, chosenBar' # chosenBar
               PROVE  C!Next
